title: LumenFrame 1.0/LF2 document normalization, catalog, and compilation boundary
summary: In-tree Python boundary of the lumenframe package (model normalization, operation/effect/transition catalog, and compilation into a renderable LayerStack) across which the engine and LF2 handoff operate.

carrier.notes: In-tree lumenframe/* package consumed by lumeri_engine_cli.py and gemia. Boundary contract only; the LF2 vector-scene authoring and LF on-demand handoff body on codex/lf2-lf-handoff-20261031 await the LF2 owner upon merge.

replaceability.why: lumenframe is the internal composition model and compiler inside lumeri-engine; external replacement happens at the sandboxed engine subcommand seams (iface:lumen.canvas/v1, iface:video.render/v1, iface:engine.gemia/v1).
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (engine internal library under sandboxed engine seams); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:164

operations.name: normalize_doc

input.description: Raw or partial lumenframe composition document dictionary.

operations.notes: Returns a fresh normalized composition dictionary without mutating the input; raises WorkAreaError when an explicit canvas.work_area span violates in >= 0 and out > in.

operations.name: compile_to_layer_stack

output.description: Compiled gemia.video.layers.LayerStack ready for render_frame() or render_to_video().

operations.notes: Orders composition children by (lane, tree-index) and compiles transforms, keyframes, expressions, masks, effects, and transitions.

operations.name: effect_types
operations.notes: Returns the canonical set of built-in effect type strings matching lumenframe.compile.EFFECTS keys.

invariants.text: normalize_doc never mutates its input and returns a valid JSON-serialisable document with a root composition layer.
effect_types() in lumenframe.catalog equals the keys of lumenframe.compile.EFFECTS with zero drift.
transition_kinds() in lumenframe.catalog covers the exact set of transition kinds implemented by the compiler.

break: An explicit canvas.work_area has in < 0 or out <= in (WorkAreaError).
strict=True is passed to compile_to_layer_stack and a layer's content cannot be resolved (CompileError).

conformance.notes: Covers the in-tree lumenframe boundary. The LF2 vector-scene authoring and LF on-demand handoff implementation on codex/lf2-lf-handoff-20261031 (5da36071) awaits the LF2 owner upon merge.

known_deviations.text: Only the in-tree lumenframe/* boundary is contracted here; the LF2 scene authoring and LF on-demand handoff body on branch codex/lf2-lf-handoff-20261031 (5da36071) is owned by the LF2 lane and not merged into this branch.

open_questions.text: When branch codex/lf2-lf-handoff-20261031 merges, the LF2 owner should extend iface:lf2.boundary/v1 with the LF2 scene and LF handoff operations.
